question: Should `optimizeImages` on `loadOutboundMediaFromUrl` and `maxDurationSeconds` on `transcodeAudioBufferToOpus` be accepted as permanent shared Plugin SDK media-helper options for the WhatsApp migration?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but these options extend reusable Plugin SDK contracts rather than remaining within the WhatsApp owner boundary; policy requires maintainer-visible direction for that API choice.

options.title: Accept the shared options
options.body: Treat both options as supported generic media-helper capabilities and merge the WhatsApp migration with its focused regression coverage.

options.title: Keep the options WhatsApp-private
options.body: Retain canonical shared primitives but redesign the WhatsApp path so its optimization and duration policy do not widen the reusable Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared options
recommendation.body: Treat both options as supported generic media-helper capabilities and merge the WhatsApp migration with its focused regression coverage.
